brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding the modifiers away.

t.zh: 逗号后面的 which 有时不指哪个名词，而指前面说的整件事。这叫，折起来以后挂在主干的谓语上。
t.en: A which after a comma sometimes refers to no noun but to the whole event just told. This is a ; folded, it hangs on the skeleton’s verb.

hint.zh: 暗示过拟合的，是“十个周期”，还是“损失在十个周期后上升”这件事？
hint.en: What suggests overfitting: ten epochs, or the loss rising after ten epochs?

sentence: The training loss increases after ten epochs, which suggests overfitting.

epochs.zh: which 若指 ten epochs，就成了“十个周期暗示过拟合”。暗示过拟合的是前面整件事：损失在上升。
epochs.en: If which meant ten epochs, ten epochs would suggest overfitting. What suggests it is the whole event before: the loss going up.

loss.zh: which 若只指 loss，就成了“损失本身暗示过拟合”。暗示过拟合的是损失在十个周期后上升这件事。
loss.en: If which meant only loss, the loss itself would suggest overfitting. What does is the loss rising after ten epochs.

title.zh: The training loss increases after ten epochs, which suggests overfitting.
title.en: The training loss increases after ten epochs, which suggests overfitting.

body.zh: which suggests overfitting 说的是前面整件事：训练损失在十个周期后上升，这说明出现了过拟合。论文里报告现象再下判断，常用这个句式。
body.en: which suggests overfitting is about the whole event before it: the training loss rising after ten epochs points to overfitting. Papers often report an observation and judge it in just this shape.

note.zh: 逗号后的 which 可以指前面整件事。
note.en: A which after a comma can stand for the whole event before it.
